context: Fix reprocessing the current (in-progress) hour to produce a partial summary instead of failing, and replace raw 500 errors from the reprocess endpoint with contextual redirect notices on the day page.

checklist.name: current_hour_reprocess_succeeds
checklist.description: Reprocessing the currently-recording hour completes without error and produces a partial summary rather than returning process.ErrChunkNotReady or a 500 response.
checklist.example: ReprocessHour detects that the requested day+hour equals the current local hour and calls the partial-pass path (ProcessCurrent) instead of the full transcribe+summarize pipeline.

checklist.name: reprocess_failure_redirects_not_500
checklist.description: When ReprocessHour returns an error, the web handler redirects (303) to the day page with a ?notice= query parameter rather than returning an HTTP 500.
checklist.example: handleReprocess calls http.Redirect(w, r, "/day/"+day+"?notice="+notice, http.StatusSeeOther) on error instead of http.Error with StatusInternalServerError.

checklist.name: notice_shown_for_still_recording
checklist.description: When the reprocess fails because an audio chunk is still being written, the day page displays a message indicating the hour is still being recorded and the user should try again later.
checklist.example: The notice key "reprocess-not-ready" maps to "That hour's audio is still being recorded — try again in a few minutes." in dayNotice.

checklist.name: notice_shown_for_media_expired
checklist.description: When the reprocess fails because the raw recordings were already removed by retention, the day page displays a message indicating the raw recordings are gone.
checklist.example: The notice key "reprocess-expired" maps to "Cannot reprocess: the hour's raw recordings were already removed." in dayNotice.

checklist.name: notice_shown_for_general_failure
checklist.description: When the reprocess fails for any other reason, the day page displays a message indicating processing failed and to check the log.
checklist.example: The notice key "reprocess-failed" maps to "Reprocessing failed — see the log." in dayNotice.

checklist.name: reprocess_error_logged
checklist.description: Reprocess failures are logged (including the day, hour, and error details) before the redirect, so they remain visible in the server log.
checklist.example: log.Printf("web: reprocess %s %02d: %v", day, hour, err) is called in handleReprocess before the redirect.

checklist.name: uses_partial_pass_abstraction
checklist.description: The current-hour branch uses the existing partial-pass pipeline method (the same one used for automatic in-progress summaries) rather than reimplementing skip logic for open chunks.
checklist.example: ReprocessHour calls p.ProcessCurrent(ctx, now, time.Time{}) for the current hour, reusing the same code path as Jobs.ProcessNow and Jobs.ProcessCurrent.

checklist.name: uses_notice_pattern
checklist.description: The error handling follows the existing day-page notice pattern: a notice key is passed as a ?notice= query param and dayNotice maps it to display text.
checklist.example: handleReprocess redirects with ?notice=reprocess-failed (etc.), and dayNotice gains matching cases — the same pattern used by handleProcessNow for process-failed.

checklist.name: sentinel_error_distinction
checklist.description: The error categorization distinguishes the audio-not-ready case and the media-expired case from generic failures using error identity checks (errors.Is) on the existing sentinel errors.
checklist.example: errors.Is(err, process.ErrChunkNotReady) and errors.Is(err, scheduler.ErrMediaExpired) select the specific notice keys; all other errors fall through to the generic notice.

checklist.name: current_hour_detection_uses_local_time
checklist.description: The check that identifies whether the requested hour is the current in-progress hour uses local time (matching the time zone convention of the rest of the jobs layer).
checklist.example: j.now().In(time.Local) is used when comparing day and hour against the current wall-clock time.

checklist.name: no_partial_pass_on_completed_hours
checklist.description: Hours that are not the currently-recording hour still go through the full reprocess pipeline (transcribe + summarize), not the partial-pass path.
checklist.example: The partial-pass branch is guarded by a condition on day == current day && hour == current hour; all other hours fall through to p.Transcribe.

checklist.name: commit_type_is_fix
checklist.description: The commit message in `COMMIT_MSG.txt` uses the Conventional Commits format and the type is `fix`, because the change corrects broken behavior: reprocessing the current hour returned a raw 500 error.
checklist.example: fix(web): reprocess the in-progress hour as a partial pass

checklist.name: commit_subject_rules
checklist.description: The first line of `COMMIT_MSG.txt` is in the imperative mood, starts with a lowercase letter after the type prefix, has no trailing period, and is at most 72 characters including the type prefix.
checklist.example: 'fix(web): reprocess the in-progress hour as a partial pass' passes; 'Added stuff.' fails (past tense, capitalized, trailing period, no type).

checklist.name: commit_not_run
checklist.description: The agent stages the changes and writes the proposed message to `COMMIT_MSG.txt`, but does not run `git commit`.
checklist.example: `COMMIT_MSG.txt` exists at the repo root; `git log` has no new commit.
